'''Feyodor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] who owned and ran [[Feyodor's Tavern]] in [[Capital City (Omman)|Capital City]] on [[Omman Minor]]. A noted [[Chef/Legends|chef]], his establishment was known for its dining options, as well as being a hub for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] to find work.<ref name="II">{{JournalCite|12|Idol Intentions}}</ref>
